# Corporate finance lab help

Follow the student-support guidance in `AGENTS.md`. Use `.assistant-resources/README.md` to locate lecture slides and key concepts for Lectures 0–3. Consult the relevant sources and PDFs before attributing an explanation to the course; identify the lecture and slide title and preserve the notebook's stated assumptions.

Help the student understand the finance and take the next small step. AI assistance and these reference materials are optional; neither is needed to run the labs.
